self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: If a Normal or Charged Attack hits within 0.3s of being fired, DMG +36% (R1) / +60% (R5); otherwise DMG -10% at every refinement. Pick "close" for the point-blank case the weapon is built around, "far" for the penalty. The bonus applies to Normal and Charged Attacks only, so it is keyed to those rather than all_dmg_. Set an uptime if a rotation lands only some of its shots inside the window.

source.note: Passive added 2026-08-23 — the weapon had no buffs at all.

en.flavor: A bow, despite the name. After countless experiments and improvements to the design, the creator of the ultimate slingshot found himself to have made what was actually a bow.

refinements.1: If a Normal or Charged Attack hits a target within 0.3s of being fired, increases DMG by <r>36%</r>. Otherwise, decreases DMG by 10%.
refinements.2: If a Normal or Charged Attack hits a target within 0.3s of being fired, increases DMG by <r>42%</r>. Otherwise, decreases DMG by 10%.
refinements.3: If a Normal or Charged Attack hits a target within 0.3s of being fired, increases DMG by <r>48%</r>. Otherwise, decreases DMG by 10%.
refinements.4: If a Normal or Charged Attack hits a target within 0.3s of being fired, increases DMG by <r>54%</r>. Otherwise, decreases DMG by 10%.
refinements.5: If a Normal or Charged Attack hits a target within 0.3s of being fired, increases DMG by <r>60%</r>. Otherwise, decreases DMG by 10%.

fr.flavor: C'est bien un arc ! Après de nombreuses modifications et améliorations, l'inventeur du lance-pierres ultime s'est finalement retrouvé avec un arc.
